label: GPT-Image 2.5 — Bild
ui_note: OpenAI filtert Inhalte. Dieses Profil formuliert deshalb nicht explizit — für explizite Motive eines der lokalen Profile wählen.

must: Full sentences with clear instructions. This model follows long, precise descriptions better than keyword stacks.
State the medium and style explicitly at the start: photograph, illustration, 3D render, oil painting.
Describe the spatial layout: what is in the foreground, middle ground and background, and where in the frame.
Any text that must appear in the image goes in quotation marks, with its position and style.
For edits, name exactly what changes and what must stay untouched.
When a subject sits, lies or leans on furniture, state the scale so proportions do not drift: 'realistic human proportions relative to the furniture, same scale as a real adult'.
avoid: Negative prompt syntax — this system has none.
Explicit sexual content — the target system rejects it.

notes_for_model: GPT-Image follows instructions rather than keywords and is strong at text inside images and at precise layout. Longer, well-structured sentences beat dense keyword stacks.
